# Alola

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Alola has 54 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 trials, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Sun and Moon (both versions).

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges.

| # | Trainer | Where | Type | Levels | Earns |

| 1 | Ilima | Melemele | Normal | 10-11 | Normalium Z |

#### Trial 1: Ilima (Melemele) -- the Normalium Z
Normal specialist. 2 Pokemon, best level 11: your team fights at level 11 at most, and on hard you bring 2 at most. Prize money: $550 on easy, $1,100 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yungoos | Normal | 10 | Tackle, Leer |
| Pikipek | Normal/Flying | 11 | Peck, Rock Smash, Growl |

**Hit them with** Rock, Fighting, Ice moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Fighting, Flying. **Tested team:** Misdreavus, Butterfree, Drifloon, Finneon, Grimer, Magnemite. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Alola by this point, raised to level 11 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 2).

Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Alola by this point, raised to level 56 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **97%** on hard (bringing the first 4).
